title: Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent-Field for the Entropic Regularization of Mean-Field Singularities
summary: We present a Quantum Boltzmann Equation self-consistent-field (QBE-SCF) formulation for molecular electronic structure in which the one-electron reduced density matrix is propagated in an atomic orbital basis and relaxed by a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator toward a Fermi-Dirac equilibrium defined by the instantaneous Fock matrix. At stationarity, the converged density and Fock matrices satisfy $[\mathbf{F},\mathbf{P}]=0$, the Hartree-Fock condition.
